answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a ferrous work bond: a stake of compute credits released only after the agent completes verified, useful jobs for real peers. Like tending a garden, reputation grows slowly through repeated honest work, while a karst of fake identities collapses because every fake must pay the same bond and the same slow build-up before earning anything, making a thousand sock puppets a thousand times costlier than one honest agent.
